title: External authority evidence record
description: One externally sourced record establishing a real authority identity (a data controller, or a counsel / rights authority). Recording a record does NOT assert that any commercial right exists, nor that the request it may unblock is answerable — it records only that a named authority, evidenced by a real source document, exists for a stated scope. rights_assertion on the substrate stays null regardless.

subject_identity.description: The evidenced identity — never a provider label, brand, or filename.

authority_scope.description: The exact assets and requirement dimensions this authority covers. A counsel record does not cover assets/requirements outside this scope (invariant I5).

source_type.description: The class of evidence document, e.g. SIGNED_APPOINTMENT, ENGAGEMENT_LETTER, CORPORATE_GOVERNANCE_RECORD, VERIFIED_INTERNAL_LEGAL_DESIGNATION, SIGNED_AUTHORITY_STATEMENT. The software does not adjudicate sufficiency; it records what was supplied.

source_reference.description: Locator of the real source document (path/id). Never fabricated.

source_digest.description: sha256 of the actual source document bytes. A document altered after ingestion no longer matches (attack 11).

effective_from.description: ISO-8601 instant the authority takes effect.

effective_until.description: ISO-8601 expiry, or null for open-ended. After this instant the record fails closed (I12).

verification_state.description: IDENTITY_EVIDENCED = the identity is known but authority is not established (not routable, invariant I2). AUTHORITY_EVIDENCED = authority is established for the scope.

revoked_at.description: ISO-8601 revocation instant; a revoked record fails closed (I12).

jurisdiction.description: REQUIRED for COUNSEL_OR_RIGHTS_AUTHORITY: the jurisdiction the counsel identity is admitted/authorized in, quoted from the appointment artifact.

appointment_authority.description: REQUIRED for COUNSEL_OR_RIGHTS_AUTHORITY: who appointed/engaged this counsel, quoted from the artifact — never inferred.

verification_metadata.description: REQUIRED for COUNSEL_OR_RIGHTS_AUTHORITY: how the identity/appointment was verified (e.g. bar registry lookup reference, countersignature check). Free-form object recorded verbatim from the verification performed.

co_validations.description: Additional validators' attestations of the SAME record content. All must be trust-verified; contradictory dispositions, confirmed scopes, or confirmed periods derive CONFLICTED (never routable).

last_verified_at.description: ISO-8601 Z instant of the most recent revalidation. Consumed by the revalidation policy (freshness); staleness derives REQUIRES_REVIEW, never deletion.

verification_epoch.description: Monotonic revalidation epoch. A record verified in an epoch below the policy minimum derives REQUIRES_REVIEW.

transition_receipt.description: The FULL signed authority-transition receipt minted at ingestion (authority_receipt.mint_receipt), retained on the record so downstream trust derivation can re-verify it against the authority receipt key instead of trusting a bare receipt-id string. Every bound field must match the record it sits on (validator_trust.ingestion_receipt_verified).

validator_identity.description: The human/legal validator who judged the artifact to constitute real authority. The software NEVER writes this block.

validated_at.description: ISO-8601 Z instant of the validation. The validator's registered authority and signing key must both have been valid at this instant.

record_binding.description: sha256 over the identity-bearing record content at validation time (see authority_lifecycle.attestation_binding). A record changed after validation no longer matches — it drops to DISCOVERED and cannot route (identity-drift fail-closed).

validator_id.description: VALIDATOR_TRUST_GOVERNANCE_V1: the registered validator id. Unregistered, unauthorized-class, expired, or revoked-at-attestation validators derive INVALIDATED.

key_id.description: The validator signing key current at validated_at (registry key window). A rotated-out key fails closed.

attestation_signature.description: Signature over the canonical attestation payload with the validator's key. hmac-sha256: 64 hex chars over validator_trust.attestation_payload. ed25519: 128 hex chars over validator_trust.attestation_payload_v2. Altering ANY attestation field after signing invalidates it.

signature_algorithm.description: Signature mode (ASYMMETRIC_VALIDATOR_KEYS_V1 dual mode). Default hmac-sha256. Must match the algorithm registered for key_id.

key_fingerprint.description: sha256 of the signing public key. REQUIRED for ed25519 attestations; must equal the fingerprint registered for key_id.

disposition.description: Default APPROVED. All-REJECTED derives INVALIDATED; mixed dispositions derive CONFLICTED.

confirmed_scope_digest.description: Optional: hash_obj of the authority_scope the validator confirmed. A mismatch with the record scope derives CONFLICTED.

confirmed_period.description: Optional: {from, until} the validator confirmed. A mismatch with the record's effective period derives CONFLICTED.

attestation.description: A human validation attestation, cryptographically bound to the record content (record_binding) and to a registered validator (signature). Absent = DISCOVERED. Untrusted = INVALIDATED. Lifecycle state itself is derived, never stored.
